name: Poztada
description: Pozole over crisp tostada shells, cabbage, radish, lime.
longDescription: Two crisp tostada shells topped with vegan beans or sour cream, then pozole, toppings, and salsas, so you get crunch in every bite instead of soup. The same way you'd dress a real tostada, just built on our hominy and protein instead of the usual fillings.

variants.label: Poztada Plate
variants.note: Two crisp tostada shells, vegan beans or sour cream, topped with pozole, toppings, and salsas.
